section.content: The application discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a positive plate, a negative plate, an isolating membrane and electrolyte; the negative plate comprises a negative current collector and a negative diaphragm; the negative diaphragm is formed by coating negative slurry containing a negative active material, a binder and a conductive agent on the surface of a negative current collector; the negative active material contains simple substance silicon and/or silicon oxide; the electrolyte contains an organic solvent, lithium salt and an additive, wherein the additive comprises cyclic carbonate containing fluorine elements, cyclic carboxylic acid lactone and a compound containing an isonitrile ester group. The working voltage of the lithium ion battery is not lower than 4.2V, and the lithium ion battery can keep good high-temperature cycle performance and normal-temperature cycle performance under high-voltage work.

本申请公开了种锂离子电池，包括正极片、负极片、隔离膜和电解液；所述负极片包括负极集流体和负极膜片；所述负极膜片由含有负极活性物质、粘结剂和导电剂的负极浆料涂布在负极集流体表面形成；所述负极活性物质中含有单质硅和/或硅的氧化物；所述电解液含有有机溶剂、锂盐和添加剂，所述添加剂包括含有氟元素的环状碳酸酯、环状羧酸内酯和含有异腈酸酯基的化合物。所述锂离子电池的工作电压不低于4.2V，可在高压工作下，保持锂离子电池良好的高温循环性能和常温循环性能。

A kind of lithium ion batteryTechnical field

The application is related to a kind of lithium ion battery, more particularly to a kind of lithium ion battery that can be worked under high voltages.

Background technology

The high-energy-density of lithium ion battery, long circulation life, wide operating temperature range and environmental protection caused its into For the main energy sources of current mobile electronic device.But, mobile electronic device was particularly smart mobile phone (gentlier, more in recent years It is thin) develop rapidly, higher demand is proposed to the energy density of lithium ion battery also.

In order to improve the energy density of lithium ion battery, conventional measure is using high-voltage anode material or using high Capacity negative electrode material.But in order to pursue higher energy density, simple any one using above two measure cannot Meet requirement of the electronic equipment for consumption to energy density, high-voltage anode material is got up to make with high-capacity cathode material collocation With having become a kind of development trend.

At present, the high-capacity cathode material that may have Practical significance is mainly Si sills.But this kind of material is being followed There is huge bulk effect during ring so that anode SEI occurs rupture during circulating battery, causes electrolyte to occur Reduction decomposition, generates substantial amounts of by-product, deteriorates cycle performance.

In view of this, it is necessory to provide the lithium ion battery that a kind of negative active core-shell material is Si bases/Sn sills, can Take into account high temperature cyclic performance and normal-temperature circulating performance simultaneously under high pressure.

The content of the invention

According to the one side of the application, there is provided a kind of lithium ion battery, the battery under high-pressure work, and can pass through suppression Electrolyte decomposition processed, slows down the generation of both positive and negative polarity interface side reaction during circulating battery, and the high temperature for improving lithium ion battery is followed Ring performance and normal-temperature circulating performance.

The lithium ion battery, including：

Positive plate, including plus plate current-collecting body and positive pole diaphragm；The positive pole diaphragm is by containing positive active material, binding agent Plus plate current-collecting body surface is coated on the anode sizing agent of conductive agent to be formed；

Negative plate, including negative current collector and cathode membrane；The cathode membrane is by containing negative electrode active material, binding agent Negative current collector surface is coated on the cathode size of conductive agent to be formed；In the negative electrode active material contain elemental silicon and/or The oxide of silicon；

Electrolyte, including organic solvent, lithium salts and additive；The additive includes the cyclic carbonate containing fluorine element Ester, cyclic carboxylic acids lactone and the compound containing NCO；

Isolating membrane；

The running voltage of the lithium ion battery is not less than 4.2V.

Preferably, the charge cutoff voltage of the lithium ion battery is not less than 4.4V.

Preferably, the positive electrode active materials of the lithium ion battery are selected from lithium and cobalt oxides, lithium nickel oxide, the oxidation of lithium manganese At least one in thing, Li, Ni, Mn oxide, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and lithium nickel cobalt aluminum oxide.

Preferably, the oxide of the silicon is SiOx, wherein 0<x<2.

Preferably, the negative electrode active material be silicon, the mixture of at least one and Delanium in the oxide of silicon. It is further preferred that the negative electrode active material contains the oxide and Delanium of silicon.It is further preferred that the negative pole Mixture of the active substance for the oxide and Delanium of silicon.

Preferably, weight/mass percentage composition of the oxide of the elemental silicon and/or silicon in negative electrode active material is not less than 15%.It is further preferred that in the negative electrode active material, the weight/mass percentage composition of the oxide of silicon is 15%～40%.More It is further preferred that in the negative electrode active material, the weight/mass percentage composition upper limit of the oxide of silicon is selected from 40%, 35%, 30%, lower limit is selected from 15%, 20%.

Preferably, the cyclic carbonate containing fluorine element selected from in the compound of chemical structural formula shown in Formulas I extremely Few one kind：

In Formulas I, R11, R12Separately selected from the fluoro-alkyl that hydrogen, fluorine or carbon number are 1～10；R11And R12It is different When be hydrogen.

Preferably, R11, R12Separately selected from the fluoro-alkyl that hydrogen, fluorine or carbon number are 1～3；R11And R12It is different When be hydrogen.It is further preferred that R11, R12Hydrogen or fluorine, and R are selected from separately11And R12It is asynchronously hydrogen.

Preferably, the cyclic carbonate containing fluorine element is fluorinated ethylene carbonate.

Preferably, the cyclic carbonate containing fluorine element weight/mass percentage composition in the electrolytic solution be 15%～ 25%.When the content in the electrolytic solution of the cyclic carbonate containing fluorine element is in this scope, not only lithium ion battery is in circulation During, be conducive to the solid electrolyte interface for repairing rupture in time (SEI, original English text solid can be abbreviated as Electrolyte interface), it is to avoid circulation is dived, and the addition of the cyclic carbonate containing fluorine element is produced with which Raw effect dependency is substantially, economically more suitable.It is further preferred that the cyclic carbonate containing fluorine element is in electricity Weight/mass percentage composition in solution liquid is 15%～20%.

Preferably, the cyclic carboxylic acids lactone is selected from the compound of chemical structural formula shown in Formula II, with formula III institute Show at least one in the compound of chemical structural formula, the compound with chemical structural formula shown in formula IV：

Wherein, R21, R22, R23, R31, R32, R33, R34, R41, R42, R43, R44, R45Hydrogen or carbon atom are selected from separately Number is 1～10 alkyl.

Preferably, R21, R22, R23, R31, R32, R33, R34, R41, R42, R43, R44, R45Separately it is selected from hydrogen or carbon is former Subnumber is 1～3 alkyl.It is further preferred that R21, R22, R23, R31, R32, R33, R34, R41, R42, R43, R44, R45It is hydrogen.

Preferably, cyclic carboxylic acids lactone weight/mass percentage composition in the electrolytic solution is 0.5%～5%.When ring-type carboxylic Acid lactone content in the electrolytic solution not only contributes to the passivation of densification is formed in cathode active material surface in this scope Film, and be not easy to increase interface impedance and the polarization of negative electrode, it is more beneficial for ensureing the cycle performance of battery.Further preferably Ground, the cyclic carboxylic acids lactone weight/mass percentage composition upper limit in the electrolytic solution are selected from 5%, 4%, 3%, lower limit selected from 0.5%, 1%th, 2%.

Preferably, the compound containing NCO is in the compound of chemical structural formula shown in Formula V At least one：

O=C=N-A-N=C=O Formula V

Wherein, A is selected from the straight-chain alkyl-sub-that carbon number is 2～10.

Preferably, A is selected from the straight-chain alkyl-sub-that carbon number is 2～6.

Preferably, the compound containing NCO weight/mass percentage composition in the electrolytic solution is 0.1～1%. When the content in the electrolytic solution of the compound containing NCO is in this scope, during less than 0.1%, one side is not enough and ring Shape carboxylic acid lactone compound cooperatively forms the high temperature resistant passivating film of densification in positive electrode surface, is on the other hand also not enough to absorb high temperature The HF constantly produced in cyclic process；When content is higher than 1%, the viscosity of electrolyte can be dramatically increased, reduce electrical conductivity, it is unfavorable In the low temperature performance of lithium ion battery.It is further preferred that the compound containing NCO is in the electrolytic solution The weight/mass percentage composition upper limit be selected from 1%, 0.8%, 0.5%, lower limit be selected from 0.1%, 0.2%, 0.3%.

Preferably, organic solvent weight/mass percentage composition in the electrolytic solution is 60%～84%.

Preferably, the organic solvent is selected from ethylene carbonate, Allyl carbonate, dimethyl carbonate, diethyl carbonate, carbon At least one in sour dipropyl, Ethyl methyl carbonate.

Preferably, at least one of the lithium salts optionally from organic lithium salt or inorganic lithium salt.

Preferably, the lithium salts is selected from LiPF6、LiBF4、LiTFSI、LiClO4、LiAsF6、LiBOB、LiDFOB、 LiTFOB、LiN(SO2RF)2、LiN(SO2F)(SO2RF) at least one, wherein substituent RF=CnF2n+1, it is saturation perfluor Alkyl, n are 1～10 integer, and 2n+1 is greater than zero integer.

Preferably, concentration of the lithium salts in the electrolyte of lithium rechargeable battery is 0.5mol/L～2mol/L.Enter Preferably, in the electrolyte, the concentration of lithium salts is 0.9mol/L～1.3mol/L to one step.

The beneficial effect that the application can be produced at least includes：

(1) lithium ion battery provided herein, by the content for controlling fluorinated ethylene carbonate (FEC) in electrolyte And add cyclic carboxylic acids lactone compound and the compound containing NCO in electrolyte, improve the electrode/electro of battery Solution liquid interface, suppresses the decomposition of electrolyte, slows down the generation of both positive and negative polarity interface side reaction during circulating battery, so as to improve lithium The high temperature cyclic performance and normal-temperature circulating performance of ion battery.

(2) lithium ion battery provided herein, negative pole adopt the oxide active material of simple substance silicon substrate and/or silicon, Can work under high pressure, running voltage is not less than 4.2V, charge cutoff voltage is not less than 4.4V.

Specific embodiment

With reference to embodiment in detail the application is described in detail, but the application is not limited to these embodiments.

In embodiment, binding agent polyvinylidene fluoride (being abbreviated as PVDF) is poly- purchased from Zhejiang Juhua Co., Ltd.'s fluorine Factory, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose thickener (being abbreviated as CMC) is purchased from Quanzhou Zhong Xin Industrial Co., Ltd.s, conductive black Super-P purchases From Tianjin gold the earth Chemical Co., Ltd., bonding agent polyacrylic acid (being abbreviated as PAA) is purchased from Aladdin reagent company limited.

The chemical property of battery is determined using the BTS series batteries test cabinet of new Weir Electronics Co., Ltd. of Shenzhen.

Comparative example 1

The preparation of electrolyte DL1：

By ethylene carbonate (EC), Allyl carbonate (PC) and diethyl carbonate (DEC) with mass ratio EC:PC:DEC= 10:30:60 mixing, obtain mixed organic solvents.Electric conducting lithium salt lithium hexafluoro phosphate (LiPF is added in organic solvent6) and fluoro Ethylene carbonate (FEC), obtains LiPF6Concentration is 1mol/L, the electrolysis that fluorinated ethylene carbonate weight/mass percentage composition is 10% Liquid.Gained electrolyte is designated as DL1.

The preparation of positive plate DP1：

By cobalt acid lithium (molecular formula LiCoO2), conductive agent Super P, binding agent polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) is in N- methyl Anode sizing agent is made in ketopyrrolidine (NMP).In anode sizing agent solids content be 77wt%, cobalt acid lithium, conduction in solid constituent The mass ratio of agent Super P and PVDF is 97:1.4:1.6.Anode sizing agent is coated in current collector aluminum foil；Dry at 85 DEG C After colded pressing；Then trimming, cut-parts are carried out, after slitting, 4h is dried under 85 DEG C of vacuum condition, soldering polar ear makes lithium Ion battery positive plate.Gained positive plate is designated as DP1.

The preparation of negative plate DN1：

Using the graphite and SiO (mass ratio 75 as negative active core-shell material：25) with conductive agent Super P, thickening agent CMC, Bonding agent polyacrylic acid (PAA) mix homogeneously in deionized water, makes cathode size.It is in cathode size, solid in cathode size Body content is 54wt%, and in solid constituent, negative active core-shell material, the mass ratio of conductive agent Super P and PAA are 92:1.0:1.0: 5.Cathode size is coated on copper foil of affluxion body and the drying at 85 DEG C；Then trimming, cut-parts are carried out, after slitting, at 120 DEG C 12h is dried under vacuum condition, soldering polar ear makes anode plate for lithium ionic cell.Gained negative plate is designated as DN1.

The preparation of lithium ion battery DC1：

Using 12 μm of polyethylene films (PE) as isolating membrane.

Obtained positive plate, barrier film, negative plate are folded in order, makes barrier film in the middle of positive/negative plate, winding is obtained Naked battery core；Naked battery core is placed in outer package, the electrolyte of above-mentioned preparation is injected in dried battery, encapsulate, stand, Chemical conversion (0.02C constant-current charges to 3.4V, then with 0.1C constant-current charges to 3.85V), shaping, volume test, complete lithium-ion electric The preparation (the thickness 4.2mm of soft-package battery, width 32mm, length 82mm) in pond.Gained lithium ion battery is designated as DC1.
